title: I launched my new card game today!
author: ElectricBrainUK
selftext:
After 4 years of work, I finally launched my first game on steam! 

It is a 1v1 card game where you build a deck of 40 cards from the 4 factions in the game (dwarves, elves, humans, and orcs). There are nearly 400 unique cards in the game which would not have been possible without utilising ai in our artwork process, for more information on that check out this video. Basically we sketched the characters, filled in the details with ai, and then touched up the output. 

https://youtu.be/FPFsaAz0yDo?is=1cn2WO0OaFAq7AVF

I have tried to blend card games that I love like Yu-Gi-Oh with my favourite pc game genre rts games like age of empires. You gather resources to build buildings and recruit units. Building your base while keeping your opponent in check. Then the battle is inspired by super auto pets. You each arrange your units into attackers and defenders to see who is stronger. 

Please let me know what you think, and thanks for taking the time to read this!

comments.author: tuptain
